title: 2015 AMC8 19
statement: A triangle with vertices at \(A=(1,3),\) \(B=(5,1),\) and \(C=(4,4)\) is plotted on a \(6\times5\) grid. What fraction of the grid is covered by the triangle?

solutions.text:
The total area of the grid is \(6\cdot5=30.\) To find the area of the triangle, place it inside the \(4\)-by-\(3\) rectangle shown below.

The rectangle has area \(4\cdot3=12.\) The three corner triangles have areas \(\dfrac12(4)(2)=4,\) \(\dfrac12(1)(3)=\dfrac32,\) and \(\dfrac12(3)(1)=\dfrac32.\) Therefore, \[\begin{aligned} [\triangle ABC] &= 12-4-\dfrac32-\dfrac32\\ &=5. \end{aligned}\]

Therefore, the fraction of the area is \(\dfrac{5}{30} = \dfrac{1}{6} .\)

Thus, the correct answer is A .
hints: Put the triangle inside a small rectangle aligned to the grid.
Subtract the three corner right triangles from the rectangle.
